# Pyrate-Style

> Leather fashion and sterling silver jewellery brand from Hamburg, Germany, founded in 1984. Made-to-measure leather jackets and trousers; handmade 925 sterling silver rings, bracelets, necklaces and accessories.

## Facts
- Founded: 1984 in Hamburg by Holger Hechtenberg and Fritz Ahrens
- The Pyrate-Style skull was the first skull ever registered as a trademark
- 2019: after Fritz Ahrens closed the shop, Giulia Christen reopened Pyrate-Style; co-founder Holger Hechtenberg joined her
- Atelier: Eppendorfer Weg 235, 20251 Hamburg, Germany
- Opening hours: Mon-Fri 11:00-19:00, Sat 11:00-18:00
- Phone: +49 40 180 081 15
- Email: info@pyrate-style.de
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pyrate.style/

## How the pieces are made
- Leather: each jacket and pair of trousers is designed and sewn in the studio, cut to the customer's measurements from a personal pattern.
- Silver: each design starts as a wax model carved by hand, is cast in 925 sterling silver and finished in the workshop. Every piece is unique.
